about_the_game:
BitFactory AutoClicker combines an intuitive auto-clicker and a robust macro recorder into a single, elegant application, empowering you to automate everything from simple clicks to multi-step procedures with ease and precision. Utilizing the Steam Workshop, BitFactory also allows its users to share their recordings with the community.

  • AutoClicker

In the "Classic" section of BitFactory, you will find a traditional auto-clicker. You can chose the key to be pressed, the interval of the press, and how many times the press is to be repeated.

  • Input Recorder

Thanks to the "Record" section, the user can record their exact movements or actions and then play them back. The recordings can be edited and changed, and users can write their own recordings using our easy to understand and straightforward language.

  • Steam Workshop

BitFactory encourages users to upload their recordings to the Steam Community, and share them with the community! BitFactory is free to use and does not lock any key features behind BitFactory Gold, so anyone can use it!
